diseases.name: Early Blight
diseases.description: A common fungal leaf disease that can reduce plant vigor and yield.
causes: Fungal spores in soil or crop debris
diseases.spread: Spores can move through splashing water, wind, tools, and infected debris.
immediate_steps: Remove heavily affected leaves with clean tools
treatment: Use crop-appropriate disease controls only as directed on product labels
Seek local extension advice for a crop-specific plan
organic: Use locally approved organic controls only according to label directions
avoid: Composting visibly diseased debris where it may survive
diseases.notes: This guide is general education, not a pesticide prescription.

diseases.name: Late Blight
diseases.description: A fast-moving plant disease that can affect foliage and tubers in favorable weather.
symptoms: Pale growth near lesion edges in humid weather
causes: Pathogen introduction from infected plant material
diseases.spread: Can spread via wind-blown spores, rain, and infected plant material.
immediate_steps: Isolate suspected plants and avoid moving wet foliage
Contact a local agricultural extension service promptly
treatment: Follow qualified local crop-protection guidance and all product labels
organic: Remove and dispose of affected material according to local guidance
care: Keep records of symptoms and dates
diseases.notes: Severe or fast-spreading symptoms need local expert support.
